scripts.build: node scripts/sync-cms-articles.mjs && npm run tokens:build && astro build
scripts.check: mkdir -p .cache/tmp .cache/quality && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 ASTRO_BASE=/ npm_config_cache="$PWD/.cache/npm" PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.cache/puppeteer" TMPDIR="$PWD/.cache/tmp" run-s check:static test
scripts.check:static: run-p format:check lint:js lint:astro lint:css lint:md lint:config typecheck lint:unused lint:duplicates audit
scripts.lint:config: npm run lint:package && npm run lint:registry && actionlint && sh -n .husky/pre-commit
scripts.lint:registry: npm config list --json --location=project | jq -e '.registry == "https://npm.flatt.tech/" and .["min-release-age"] == 7 and .["engine-strict"] == true and .["save-exact"] == true'
scripts.typecheck: astro check --minimumFailingSeverity warning && tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --skipLibCheck tests/notebook.spec.ts
scripts.lint:unused-css: mkdir -p .cache/quality && purgecss --css 'src/styles/*.css' --content 'dist/**/*.html' --safelist h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 p a ul ol li blockquote pre code hr table thead tbody tr th td figure img video iframe data-notebook-rows --rejected > .cache/quality/purgecss.json && jq -e 'length > 0 and all(.[]; (.rejected | length) == 0)' .cache/quality/purgecss.json
scripts.test:notebook: CHROME_PATH="$(PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.cache/puppeteer" puppeteer browsers install chrome-headless-shell --format '{{path}}')" playwright test tests/notebook.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=list --output=.cache/quality/notebook-tests
scripts.audit:performance: CHROME_PATH="$(PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.cache/puppeteer" puppeteer browsers install chrome-headless-shell --format '{{path}}')" lhci collect && lhci assert && lhci upload
